on Citavi6.ProjectUser.UserID = foo.UserID and Citavi6.ProjectUser.ProjectName = foo.ProjectName
when matched then
update set LastAccess = foo.LastAccess
when not matched then
insert (UserID, ProjectName, LastAccess, Concurrent)
values (UserID, ProjectName, LastAccess, Concurrent);
